answer: Require each identity to keep a steady rest cycle, like tides in an ocean that always return on their own schedule: several quiet hours each epoch, the same window every cycle. A lone agent rests and works in its own rhythm, and its quartz-steady pattern becomes a mirror of a real life lived over time. A farm's clones never sleep, or all sleep at the same instant - either way the pattern betrays them, and forcing each fake to idle for hours cuts its earnings per clone.
